findings.finding: Q3 2026 was an extreme wholesale-price quarter for Naturgy's integrated gas and power book. The OMIE Spanish day-ahead price averaged ~124 EUR/MWh (Jul 107, Aug 121, Sep 144) against ~67 in Q3 2025, and ~161 so far in October. September demand rose 14.5% and wind output fell 17.7%, so CCGTs ran more, with European gas above 70 EUR/MWh (more than double a year earlier). In H1, when prices were lower, Naturgy's Spanish thermal EBITDA was +34% and Supply -17%. This points to a Q3 slightly above a bar that implies flat EBITDA, and gives some chance of a second 2026 guide raise, because the July guide was set on forwards as of 20/07.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Observed on actual results days: H1 26 guide raise +3.44%; FY24 + new plan +4.34%; reiterations 9M25 -0.45%, 1H25 -0.94%, 9M24 +0.34%; FY25 (flat 2026 guide) -3.55%; Q1 26 -2.89%.
findings.original_quote: "Venimos de un septiembre con un 14,46% más de demanda que hace un año y una caída de la generación eólica del 17,7%", ... esa combinación aumentó la necesidad de recurrir a los ciclos combinados justo cuando el gas costaba más del doble en comparativa interanual. [Translation: 'We come from a September with 14.46% more demand than a year ago and a 17.7% fall in wind generation' ... that combination increased the need for combined cycles just when gas cost more than double year on year.] OMIE monthly averages are my own computation from the daily marginalpdbc files, e.g. https://www.omie.es/es/file-download?parents%5B0%5D=marginalpdbc&filename=marginalpdbc_20260915.1
findings.why_not_priced: Half-priced. The price environment is public and the stock is +3.7% over 20 days, near its 31.10 high of 23 Oct. What is not public is how much of the spike Naturgy captured after hedges and supply losses. The RBC bar (Q3 EBITDA +1% yoy) shows the sell-side has not modelled a large Q3 gain, and nothing since July guides on it. If the market expected an upgrade, the stock would not have given back 1.2% over five days into the print. This is still macro-to-company transmission with no company statement, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Iberdrola raised its 2026 guide on its 9M print on 21 Oct (https://www.iberdrola.com/sala-comunicacion/noticias/detalle/iberdrola-incrementa-beneficio-neto-10-hasta-5816-m-eur-gracias-inversiones-record-10087-m-eur-9-meses-2026), a different mix that is mostly networks. Naturgy's own H1 slide 'Recent trends point to renewed volatility and upside price risk' (https://www.naturgy.com/files/Naturgy_1H26_Results_Presentation.pdf).

findings.finding: Endesa, the closest Spanish integrated peer, reported 9M26 today (28 Oct). Net income 1,962m (+15%) and EBITDA 4,577m (+8%) against H1's 1,470m and 3,240m (+20%) imply Q3 2026 EBITDA ~1,337m against ~1,524m (-12%) and Q3 net income ~492m against ~668m (-26%). It only confirmed its >2.4bn guide 'even under more demanding market conditions in Q4' and warned of a storm ahead for the sector. The stock fell ~2% on the day. So the same price spike hurt an integrated Spanish book in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed Naturgy reaction to an Endesa read-through. Naturgy fell 0.65% on 28 Oct, the day Endesa printed, which is inside the entry close.
findings.original_quote: El grupo confirma su previsión de superar los 2.400 millones de beneficio ordinario neto en 2026, "incluso ante unas condiciones de mercado más exigentes en el cuarto trimestre". El resultado bruto operativo (ebitda) aumenta un 8%, hasta 4.577 millones. [Translation: The group confirms its forecast of exceeding 2,400 million in ordinary net profit in 2026, 'even in the face of more demanding market conditions in the fourth quarter'. EBITDA rises 8% to 4,577 million.] Q3 figures derived using H1 26 (https://www.endesa.com/es/prensa/sala-de-prensa/noticias/informacion-economica/resultado-primer-semestre-2026) and 9M25 (https://www.endesa.com/en/press/press-room/news/economic-information/september-2025-results).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. It was published this morning and Naturgy's -0.65% today sits in the entry close. What may not be priced is that the Q3 deterioration is a quarter-specific number (-12% EBITDA) that nobody derived in the headline coverage, which reported +15%/+8% year to date. Naturgy's mix is more CCGT and gas than Endesa's power-retail-heavy book, so the transmission is partial. Sized small, net of that difference.
findings.independence: Naturgy's own H1 report: Supply EBITDA -17.4% on system costs and the regulated gas tariff (https://www.naturgy.com/files/Naturgy_Resultados_Informe_ESP_1S26.pdf). That is the same squeeze mechanism, from a different document.

findings.finding: Moeve has launched aggressive fuel discounts tied to cross-selling Naturgy power and gas, answering Repsol's EUR 1,000 new-customer offer and Iberdrola's campaigns. This marks a Spanish retail price war during a wholesale spike and points to more pressure on supply margins and higher acquisition costs in Q4 commentary.
findings.original_quote: Las ofertas de Moeve, como están vinculadas a ventas cruzadas de luz y gas proporcionados por Naturgy (tercera eléctrica y primera gasista en España), también beneficiarán a los usuarios que contraten estos servicios con esta compañía. [Translation: Moeve's offers, as they are tied to cross-sales of electricity and gas supplied by Naturgy, will also benefit users who contract these services with this company.]
findings.why_not_priced: Public since 21 Oct and small. The discounts are mostly Moeve's fuel discounts, and who bears the cost on the Naturgy side is not stated. It only matters if management flags Q4 supply margin pressure. The lessons pass sized it at 0 because it is a proxy with no number.

outside_window.finding: EU Advocate General Rantos backed the 2022-23 windfall solidarity levy as legitimate (22 Oct). This strengthens the political path to a renewed energy windfall tax, which Spain has pushed in Brussels since April 2026. The CJEU ruling and any new levy fall after the window.

baseline_tension: Roughly orthogonal to the lean. The run-up (+3.7% over 20 days, -1.2% over 5) is mild, and the findings offset each other: a favourable Q3 price environment against a weak Q3 from the closest peer. Nothing here agrees with or fights the run-up in a way that beats the free control.

lessons_applied: Macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until the company says it: finding 1 cut from +0.8 to +0.5, and p_up from 53 to 52.
The move is in the guide, and understatement is systematic: abs_move_pct raised from 2.8 to 3.2 because a guide change is live, not pulled toward the ~1.9% median reaction.
